name: data-governance-guidance-corpus
title: Data Governance Guidance Corpus (GOV.UK)
description: Public-sector data-governance and IT-modernization guidance documents ingested from GOV.UK via its public Search and Content APIs, for the Data Governance Guidance Search demo. Each record is tagged with a simulated access tier derived deterministically from its GOV.UK publication format (impact assessments, or sensitivity-classification language -> restricted; policy papers/consultations/corporate reports/statutory guidance/correspondence/research -> internal; otherwise public).

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Simulated access tier: public | internal | restricted
